tables.name: acquisition_roots
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE acquisition_roots(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collection_runs(id), repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repositories(id), object_format TEXT NOT NULL, oid BLOB NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL, pr_number INTEGER, observation_id INTEGER, expected_oid TEXT, published INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, UNIQUE(run_id,oid,role)) STRICT

tables.name: api_responses
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE api_responses(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, payload_sha256 BLOB NOT NULL, body BLOB NOT NULL, UNIQUE(payload_sha256,body)) STRICT

tables.name: blob_content_map
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE blob_content_map(object_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES git_objects(id), content_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES contents(id), run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collection_runs(id)) STRICT

tables.name: cache_entries
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE cache_entries(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repositories(id), generation INTEGER NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, state TEXT NOT NULL, last_used REAL NOT NULL, bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, UNIQUE(repo_id,generation)) STRICT

tables.name: cache_leases
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE cache_leases(cache_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cache_entries(id), job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id), attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, acquired_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(cache_id,job_id)) STRICT

tables.name: catalog_meta
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE catalog_meta(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), db_instance_id TEXT NOT NULL, publication_seq INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT

tables.name: collection_memberships
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE collection_memberships(collection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collections(id), resource_id TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(collection_id,resource_id)) STRICT

tables.name: collection_pages
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE collection_pages(collection_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collections(id), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, response_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES api_responses(id), request TEXT NOT NULL, next_cursor TEXT, observed_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(collection_id,ordinal)) STRICT

tables.name: collection_runs
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE collection_runs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id), repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repositories(id), cache_id TEXT REFERENCES cache_entries(id), generation INTEGER NOT NULL, attempt INTEGER NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, started_at TEXT NOT NULL, refs_at TEXT, ended_at TEXT, object_format TEXT CHECK(object_format IN ('sha1','sha256')), kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'git', roots_manifest TEXT, request TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', endpoint_id TEXT REFERENCES repository_endpoints(id), endpoint_url TEXT, UNIQUE(repo_id,generation,kind)) STRICT

tables.name: collections
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE collections(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, pr_id TEXT REFERENCES pull_requests(id), repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repositories(id), kind TEXT NOT NULL, job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id), state TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, cursor TEXT, observed_at TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT) STRICT

tables.name: commit_parents
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE commit_parents(commit_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES commits(object_id), parent_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(parent_ordinal>=0), parent_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES git_objects(id), PRIMARY KEY(commit_id,parent_ordinal)) STRICT

tables.name: commits
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE commits(object_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES git_objects(id), tree_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES git_objects(id), raw_headers BLOB NOT NULL, raw_message BLOB NOT NULL, metadata TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

tables.name: content_digests
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE content_digests(content_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES contents(id), representation TEXT NOT NULL, algorithm TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(algorithm IN ('md5','sha1','sha256')), digest BLOB NOT NULL CHECK((algorithm='md5' AND length(digest)=16) OR (algorithm='sha1' AND length(digest)=20) OR (algorithm='sha256' AND length(digest)=32)), verified_at TEXT NOT NULL, pipeline_version TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(content_id,representation,algorithm)) STRICT

tables.name: content_locations
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE content_locations(content_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES contents(id), kind TEXT NOT NULL, locator TEXT NOT NULL, cache_id TEXT REFERENCES cache_entries(id), state TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(content_id,kind,locator)) STRICT

tables.name: contents
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE contents(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, byte_length INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(byte_length>=0), raw_text TEXT, text_state TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

tables.name: coverage_components
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE coverage_components(owner_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, details TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY(owner_id,kind)) STRICT

tables.name: document_versions
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE document_versions(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, document_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pr_documents(id), body TEXT NOT NULL, body_sha256 BLOB NOT NULL CHECK(length(body_sha256)=32), UNIQUE(document_id,body_sha256,body)) STRICT

tables.name: git_objects
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE git_objects(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, object_format TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(object_format IN ('sha1','sha256')), oid BLOB NOT NULL CHECK((object_format='sha1' AND length(oid)=20) OR (object_format='sha256' AND length(oid)=32)), type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(type IN ('commit','tree','blob','tag')), size INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(size>=0), verified INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, UNIQUE(object_format,oid)) STRICT

tables.name: index_generations
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE index_generations(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, table_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, target_max_id INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

tables.name: index_membership
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE index_membership(generation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES index_generations(id), document_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES search_documents(id), input_version TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(generation_id,document_id,input_version)) STRICT

tables.name: inventory_runs
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE inventory_runs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id), state TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, observed_at TEXT NOT NULL, reason TEXT) STRICT

tables.name: jobs
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE jobs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL, request TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, attempt INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, not_before REAL, checkpoint TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', reason TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

tables.name: pr_code_observations
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE pr_code_observations(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, pr_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pull_requests(id), observation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pr_observations(id), head_oid TEXT, base_oid TEXT, state TEXT NOT NULL, details TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

tables.name: pr_commits
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE pr_commits(code_observation INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pr_code_observations(id), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, oid TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(code_observation,ordinal)) STRICT

tables.name: pr_documents
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE pr_documents(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, pr_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pull_requests(id), kind TEXT NOT NULL, provider_id TEXT NOT NULL, node_id TEXT, author TEXT, url TEXT, current_version INTEGER, deleted INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', UNIQUE(pr_id,kind,provider_id)) STRICT

tables.name: pr_events
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE pr_events(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, pr_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pull_requests(id), run_id TEXT NOT NULL, ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, provider_id TEXT, payload TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(run_id,ordinal)) STRICT

tables.name: pr_file_changes
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE pr_file_changes(code_observation INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pr_code_observations(id), ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL, path TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(code_observation,ordinal)) STRICT

tables.name: pr_git_links
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE pr_git_links(code_observation INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES pr_code_observations(id), role TEXT NOT NULL, object_format TEXT NOT NULL, oid BLOB NOT NULL, acquisition_id INTEGER REFERENCES acquisition_roots(id), PRIMARY KEY(code_observation,role,oid)) STRICT

tables.name: pr_observations
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE pr_observations(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, pr_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pull_requests(id), job_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES jobs(id), observed_at TEXT NOT NULL, payload TEXT NOT NULL, published INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1) STRICT

tables.name: pr_reviews
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE pr_reviews(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, pr_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pull_requests(id), document_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pr_documents(id), payload TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

tables.name: preservation_obligations
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE preservation_obligations(run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES collection_runs(id), cache_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES cache_entries(id), roots_fixed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, structure_done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, digest_done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, text_done INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, published INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0) STRICT

tables.name: pull_requests
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE pull_requests(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repositories(id), number INTEGER NOT NULL, node_id TEXT, current_observation INTEGER, UNIQUE(repo_id,number)) STRICT

tables.name: ref_observations
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE ref_observations(snapshot_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES snapshots(id), raw_ref_name BLOB NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, object_format TEXT NOT NULL, target_oid BLOB NOT NULL, peeled_oid BLOB, target_type TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(snapshot_id,raw_ref_name)) STRICT

tables.name: repositories
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE "repositories"(
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id),
    provider_host TEXT NOT NULL,
    provider_repo_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    url TEXT NOT NULL,
    metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    current_snapshot TEXT
) STRICT

tables.name: repository_bindings
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE repository_bindings(
    repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repositories(id),
    instance_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES service_instances(id),
    provider_repo_id TEXT,
    metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(repo_id,instance_id),
    UNIQUE(instance_id,provider_repo_id),
    CHECK(provider_repo_id IS NULL OR length(provider_repo_id)>0)
) STRICT

indexes.name: endpoint_preferred
indexes.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX endpoint_preferred ON repository_endpoints(repo_id) WHERE is_preferred=1

tables.name: repository_endpoints
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE repository_endpoints(
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repositories(id),
    url TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(url)>0),
    transport TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(transport IN ('file','https','ssh','other')),
    label TEXT,
    is_preferred INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(is_preferred IN (0,1)),
    metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE(repo_id,url)
) STRICT

tables.name: repository_names
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE repository_names(repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repositories(id), name TEXT NOT NULL, observed_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(repo_id,name)) STRICT

tables.name: repository_object_sources
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE repository_object_sources(repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repositories(id), object_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES git_objects(id), run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES collection_runs(id), PRIMARY KEY(repo_id,object_id,run_id)) STRICT

tables.name: resource_observations
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE resource_observations(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, document_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pr_documents(id), version_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES document_versions(id), collection_run TEXT NOT NULL, observed_at TEXT NOT NULL, metadata TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(collection_run,document_id)) STRICT

tables.name: review_comments
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE review_comments(document_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES pr_documents(id), thread_id TEXT REFERENCES review_threads(id), payload TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

tables.name: review_threads
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE review_threads(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, pr_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pull_requests(id), payload TEXT NOT NULL, observed_at TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

tables.name: root_manifest_entries
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE root_manifest_entries(tree_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES root_manifests(tree_id), raw_path BLOB NOT NULL, mode INTEGER NOT NULL, object_id INTEGER REFERENCES git_objects(id), object_format TEXT NOT NULL, oid BLOB NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(tree_id,raw_path)) STRICT

tables.name: root_manifests
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE root_manifests(tree_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES git_objects(id), complete INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0) STRICT

tables.name: schema_migrations
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE schema_migrations(version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, checksum TEXT NOT NULL, applied_at TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

tables.name: search_documents
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE search_documents(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('code','commits','pr')), source_key TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', UNIQUE(kind,source_key)) STRICT

tables.name: service_instances
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE service_instances(
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('github','gitlab','gitea','forgejo','gitolite','git','other')),
    name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    web_base_url TEXT,
    api_base_url TEXT,
    metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT

tables.name: snapshots
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE snapshots(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, run_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES collection_runs(id), repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repositories(id), generation INTEGER NOT NULL, published INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE(repo_id,generation)) STRICT

tables.name: source_repositories
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE source_repositories(
    source_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sources(id),
    repo_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES repositories(id),
    first_seen TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_seen TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(source_id,repo_id)
) STRICT

tables.name: sources
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE sources(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('local-git','github')), name TEXT NOT NULL, settings TEXT NOT NULL, instance_id TEXT REFERENCES service_instances(id)) STRICT

tables.name: space_reservations
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE space_reservations(job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES jobs(id), reserved INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(reserved>=0), consumed INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(consumed>=0)) STRICT

tables.name: sync_checkpoints
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE sync_checkpoints(scope TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

tables.name: tag_objects
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE tag_objects(object_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES git_objects(id), target_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES git_objects(id), raw_payload BLOB NOT NULL) STRICT

tables.name: tree_entries
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE tree_entries(tree_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES git_objects(id), raw_name BLOB NOT NULL, mode INTEGER NOT NULL, child_format TEXT NOT NULL, child_oid BLOB NOT NULL, child_id INTEGER REFERENCES git_objects(id), PRIMARY KEY(tree_id,raw_name)) STRICT
